market_question: Will Keisha Lance Bottoms win the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic primary election?
reasoning: Keisha Lance Bottoms has not declared her candidacy and the 2026 Democratic primary field remains wide open. Even if she runs, she will likely face strong challengers, making the current 93.9% implied probability unreasonably high. A realistic win probability is closer to 70–75%.
evidence_points: No official announcement from Bottoms as of early 2025.
Potential competitors include Stacey Abrams (if she runs again), Andre Dickens, Bee Nguyen, and others, all of whom have bases of support.
Gubernatorial primaries for a party out of power since 1998 are rarely a coronation; contested primaries are the norm.
